raw.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT source_path, engine, attn, image_px, patches, mean_ms, ci95_ms,
         aic_pred_ms, ratio_meas_over_aic, is_valid, note
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE image_px = 448 AND patches = 784
), pool AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM provenance.v_pool_latency p
  JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id)
  WHERE p.is_current = true AND d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn) AS collector_denominator_all,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid = true) AS collector_denominator_valid,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM target) AS target_rows_all,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS target_rows_valid,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM target WHERE mean_ms = 11.360 AND ci95_ms = 0.006 AND aic_pred_ms = 7.822 AND round(ratio_meas_over_aic::numeric, 2) = 1.45) AS exact_claim_rows,
  (SELECT min(mean_ms) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_mean_min_ms,
  (SELECT max(mean_ms) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_mean_max_ms,
  (SELECT min(ci95_ms) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_ci95_min_ms,
  (SELECT max(ci95_ms) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_ci95_max_ms,
  (SELECT min(aic_pred_ms) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_pred_min_ms,
  (SELECT max(aic_pred_ms) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_pred_max_ms,
  (SELECT min(ratio_meas_over_aic) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_ratio_min,
  (SELECT max(ratio_meas_over_aic) FROM target WHERE is_valid = true) AS valid_ratio_max,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pool) AS v_pool_current_denominator,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY source_path, engine, attn) FROM target t) AS target_breakdown,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x.window_name, x.source_relation) FROM (
     SELECT window_name, source_relation, count(*) AS rows
     FROM pool GROUP BY window_name, source_relation
   ) x) AS v_pool_window_breakdown;
